test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'ABROAD' is coded as 'WZLIYZ' and 'ADVISE' is coded as 'VHREWZ'. How will 'AGENDA' be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 'ABROAD' is coded as 'WZLIYZ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40ddf357197746fceb573f1c4d7f52d66dcd9a46099f8d6aeff3f0ecf0cb74d2.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49fb726c6c87af211416a1229d3b94e85c3dce150ace74e638b93a538fb871dd.png] 

'ADVISE' is coded as 'VHREWZ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a239343beedac91303c544ab7d62353352fe27d7e4edbf3f91e455b814f13e6a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46ce95be53360bab144472a90358bd0cc0b0f767d0ec0039b80585379e25735d.png] 

Similarly,

'AGENDA' is coded as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdb6a5665990f7882dd75a1bff7f1ece94b19f6b5e3584cfdfa50d8c3ebd6b11.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77eb672da3ee43fad6e38d1ae1986de3fbac4b2c1b3bf20a3169f47c8236288a.png] 

Thus, 'AGENDA' is coded as 'ZWMVTZ'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
